segments.text: Welcome to a demo of our product analytics dashboard.
The home screen shows daily active users at the top.
Right below it we display weekly retention as a cohort grid.
Each cell in the grid is colored by retention percentage.
Click any cohort to drill into the individual users it contains.
The funnel view tracks conversion across signup, activation, and purchase.
You can add a filter to segment the funnel by acquisition channel.
Filters apply instantly without reloading the page.
The events explorer lets you build custom charts from raw events.
Save any chart to a shared dashboard for your team.
Scheduled reports can be emailed every Monday morning automatically.
Data exports are available as CSV or through the query API.
Role based access controls who can view sensitive revenue metrics.
That concludes the analytics dashboard walkthrough.
